examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Four numbered stages on dark textured cards. Below the large breakpoint the row scrolls sideways and snaps; focus the row and use the arrow keys to scroll it.

examples.name: Pinned
examples.summary: The careers hiring process: five tall stages under a centered title. With `pinned`, from the large breakpoint the band stays under the site header while the page scroll slides the cards sideways until the last one is in view; below it, or under reduced motion, the row scrolls sideways on its own.
